description: Fourth round: NaN-keeping ReLUs from TileLang's existing surface (T.clamp; dot < 0 ? 0 : dot) against r6k, the generated CUDA and TVM analyzer on x != x, and what the index quantizer makes of NaN and inf beside TileKernels' reference.
argv: import os, subprocess, sys; codes = [subprocess.call([sys.executable, '/b/bench_relu4.py']), subprocess.call([sys.executable, '/b/probe_quant_nan.py'])]; env = dict(os.environ, PYTHONPATH='/b' + os.pathsep + os.environ.get('PYTHONPATH', '')); RUNS = [('indexer=/b/indexer_clamp.py', 'indexer', 'tests/kernels/attention/test_deepseek_v41_tilelang.py'), ('indexer=/b/indexer_lt.py', 'indexer', 'tests/kernels/attention/test_deepseek_v41_tilelang.py')]; codes += [subprocess.call([sys.executable, '-m', 'pytest', '-q', '--noconftest', '-p', 'no:cacheprovider', '-p', 'swap_plugin', '-rfEPxX', '-k', k, path], env=dict(env, SWAP=swap)) for swap, k, path in RUNS]; print('exit codes (bench, quantizer probe (report only), clamp tests, lt tests)', codes); sys.exit(max(codes))
